task: scatter ForceImport cleanup #41 — kill '[SceneSetup] missing:' warnings for stone_chunk_small/dead_leaves/pebble_scatter
change_summary: Updated 3 ForceImportAllSprites entries in SceneSetup.cs from dead 'Assets/Sprites/' paths to live 'Assets/Resources/scatter/' paths. The PNGs were already relocated to Assets/Resources/scatter/ by the W-M4-04 Lane B wave; the SceneSetup list was left pointing at the old Sprites/ location, producing 3 '[SceneSetup] missing:' warnings on every scene-regen. The Resources/scatter/ .meta files were already correct (Sprite type, FilterMode Point, PPU 16) — no .meta edits required.
design_decision: Updated paths rather than removing entries, because batchmode ForceImport (lesson #1) is still needed even for Resources-folder assets to guarantee the .meta is applied before any LoadAssetAtPath<Sprite>() call during GenerateAll(). Removing the entries would re-introduce the sprite-import-race for these three assets.
qa_flag: SCENESET-HOT: SceneSetup.cs ForceImportAllSprites list — the wave's single sanctioned SceneSetup-hot touch. Acceptance: scene-regen produces ZERO '[SceneSetup] missing:' warnings for stone_chunk_small/dead_leaves/pebble_scatter. The 3 decals must still render as real chunk/leaf/pebble sprites (no magenta dots, no missing-sprite warnings in regen log). Resources/scatter/ PNGs and their .meta files are untouched.
